modules.certificate_mesh_scope: Actual source-module meshes named and hashed below. Whole-holder exported topology is audited separately; these geometry certificates transfer through rigid assembly when mechanism surfaces are preserved apart from bounded coordinate rounding.

continuous_rotation.proof: Each unsampled angle is within half one angular step of a sample; every moving point travels at most2*rho_max*sin(step/4).

initial_print_connectivity.scope: Checks captive moving-part startup at0.01,0.04,0.10mm above its first material; this is not a full support or slicer certification.

extraction.retained_stump_state: Actual central-piece mesh and matching nominal break-plane stumps; maximum stumps are separately covered by the rotation certificate.
extraction.certificate: Original solid plus all forward-facing triangle prisms covers its full straight sweep. Convex bounds are recursively divided until clear or an exact single-triangle prism is reached.

support_projection_separation.proof: Positive-fill XY projections of complete actual wire meshes are extruded to a common slab. Their separation is unchanged by any relative translation along Z and therefore bounds wire-to-wire extraction clearance continuously.

modules.play_allowance_method: Maximum of opposed measured journal bounds per interface, including export rounding; accumulated along each nested parent-child chain.
scope: The motion certificate includes the actual maximum retained breakaway stumps supplied in each layer mesh.
Centered continuous360degree relative rotation is certified for adjacent layers; independent rotations compose because they share one axis.
Bearing retention uses measured tip/stop/mouth coordinates with conservative opposite-endplay and tilt allowances.
Wall envelopes and nonadjacent spherical separation include the cumulative measured relative centre displacement along the intervening bearing chain.
Tool access and extraction apply to the declared aligned print orientation and declared release order.
Manufacturing tolerances, cured-resin friction and actual fracture behaviour still depend on the selected resin and printer.
